test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct idiom to replace the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Harry always __speaks his eye__ but he is not always very diplomatic!
solution:
The correct answer is: **speaks his mind**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**speaks his mind**" means to express one's honest and direct opinions or thoughts. (किसी की ईमानदार और सीधी राय या विचार व्यक्त कर
